title: Ned's Box of Bits
checkpoint: Reception Spring 1, week 1 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds x, y, z
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 3, 29-sound stage (x, y, z just added).

pages.illustration: Ned the duckling standing beside a small open wooden box at the edge of a stream, gold feathers bright.
Ned the duckling digging with his bill in soft brown mud at the stream edge.

pages.text: Ned gets a nut. Ned pops it in.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling dropping a small brown nut into the wooden box.

pages.text: Ned gets a peg. Ned pops it in.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling dropping a plain wooden peg into the box, next to the nut.

pages.text: Ned gets a big rock. It will not fit!
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling holding a grey rock that is too big, next to the box, looking worried.
Ned the duckling digging a bigger hole in the mud beside the stream, rock set down nearby.

pages.text: Ned gets the rock in the box.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling pushing the grey rock down into the wooden box with his bill.

pages.text: Is Ned sad? No! Ned has a box of bits. Ned has fun.
pages.illustration: Ned the duckling sitting happily beside the box, now full with the nut, peg and rock, stream behind him.
